subject: Need your sign-off before 2pm today
body:
Hi Alex,

Sorry for the short notice — legal just sent back the final version of the vendor contract with Meridian Supply, and we need someone with signing authority to approve it before 2:00 PM today so we don't lose the negotiated rate.

I've attached the redlined PDF. The only changes from the last version are in section 4 (payment terms) and section 7 (liability cap), both of which legal has already cleared.

Can you take a quick look and send a reply confirming you're good to sign? Happy to hop on a call if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Jason

subject: [CSE416] 팀 프로젝트 중간 발표 일정 안내
body:
임동현 학생 안녕하세요,

CSE416 팀 프로젝트 중간 발표가 11월 20일(목) 오후 2시로 확정되었습니다. 발표 시간은 팀당 10분이며, 발표 자료는 11월 18일까지 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.

발표 순서에 대한 선호가 있으시면 이번 주 금요일까지 회신 부탁드립니다.

감사합니다.
김지수 드림

subject: Re: Re: API rate limiting design
body:
Hey Alex,

Following up on the thread below. I think token bucket per API key is the way to go, but Sam raised a fair point about burst traffic from the mobile app. Three things I need from you:

1. Do you agree with token bucket over sliding window?
2. What burst size should we allow for mobile clients?
3. Can you review my PR (#482) by Monday?

Thanks,
Dev

> On Thu, Nov 6, Sam Lee wrote:
> Token bucket is fine but mobile clients retry aggressively on reconnect...
>> On Wed, Nov 5, Alex Kim wrote:
>> Let's decide on the algorithm this week.
instructions: agree with token bucket, burst of 50 for mobile, will review PR Monday morning
